source_text.Q-1038: LOW, CI lane, owner letflow-3. Queue Q-1038 / GH #2365, queue issue_ref ISS-1038. Source: letflow-3 CI speed analysis (Q-1037 / GH #2364 comment). Evidence: the 'Detect changed paths' filter in .github/workflows/ci.yml only matches lib/, priv/repo/migrations/, test/, mix.exs, mix.lock, .tool-versions, config/ and .github/workflows/ci.yml, so a PR that changes scripts/test_parallel.sh (the partition runner the backend gate itself uses) gets backend=false and the backend gate is skipped on that PR. Fix: add scripts/test_parallel.sh and any other script the backend gate itself runs (read what `mix letflow.check` and the gate steps invoke under scripts/) to the backend pattern; keep the A3 / merge_group behaviour intact; required check names unchanged. Test: a throwaway PR touching only scripts/test_parallel.sh shows the backend gate running (run id quoted); a docs-only PR still skips it. Related: Q-1037. Acceptance: (1) scripts/test_parallel.sh and every other script executed by the backend gate are in the backend path pattern; (2) a PR touching only scripts/test_parallel.sh runs the backend gate (run id quoted); a docs-only PR still skips it; (3) merge_group trigger and required check names unchanged. Supervisor rules: check names byte-exact, NO aggregator / branch-protection change (that is the user's), full local gates, PR body per template; diff of the filter only.
